changes.description: Converted all non-input/output/signal properties to signals across all components and most services.

Removed old code responsible for waiting for the user's data to be resolved in various authenticated-only components. Now that we use route guards to ensure users are authenticated before vising these routes, we don't need to manually wait for the auth checks.
Deleted unnecessary unused imports and properties from various components (including the full list, search results, the single post and the main page) and from the Items Service.
Removed incorrect ARIA roles from the main page's post lists, which might've caused confusion for anyone using assistive technology.
